\[
-2 \cdot \sin(x) \cdot \cos(x) = \frac{d}{dx}\left(-\sin(x)^2\right),
\]
the antiderivative is:

\[
\int -2 \cdot \sin(x) \cdot \cos(x) \, dx = -\sin(x)^2 + C
\]

<answer>-sin(x)**2 + C</answer>
